plugin.name: resist-edge
plugin._long: Triggers an action when the mouse hits the top-left screen corner.

option.name: command
option._long: A shell command to execute when the cursor enters the hot corner.

option.name: cooldown-time
option._long: The amount of time (in milliseconds) to wait before allowing another trigger. Prevents accidental multiple executions in quick succession.

option.name: resistance
option._long: Controls how much the mouse is slowed down when hitting the corner. 0.0 means full resistance (mouse stops), 1.0 means no resistance.

option.name: corner
option._long: Specifies which screen corner will activate the resist edge behavior. Supported values: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right

option.name: edge-width
option._long: The width (in pixels) of the active area along the screen edge.

option.name: edge-height
option._long: The height (in pixels) of the active area along the screen edge.
